name: Stolen Blasting Powder

angles.text: Gol'Bolar Quarry provides stone and resources vital to Ironforge. For a dwarf, the security of its mining explosives is an urgent concern.
Blasting powder is volatile and dangerous. As an engineer, you know the havoc troggs could cause with unauthorized explosives.
Quarry operations depend on controlled demolitions to extract stone. Missing powder kegs signal grave danger inside the excavation pits.
For the Alliance, securing Dun Morogh's supply lines and mining outposts from trogg incursions is essential to operations across Khaz Modan.

faq.answer: Stolen Blasting Powder concerns an empty keg stamped with hazardous warnings, found among troggs near Gol'Bolar Quarry. It alerts Quarrymaster Thesten to the theft of volatile mining supplies.
Bring the empty powder keg directly to Quarrymaster Thesten, who oversees operations at Gol'Bolar Quarry in Dun Morogh.
faq.q: Who should receive the empty powder keg?

faq.answer: The keg bears quarrymaster authorization warnings and held hazardous blasting powder. Troggs with heavy explosives threaten the quarry excavation and nearby settlements.
faq.q: Why is the stolen blasting powder dangerous?

faq.answer: Gol'Bolar Quarry is a dwarven excavation site in Dun Morogh that quarries stone and minerals for Ironforge.
Quarrymaster Thesten turns pale at the sight of the empty keg and asks where it was found. He knows its dangerous contents have already fallen into hostile trogg hands.
faq.q: Why does Quarrymaster Thesten turn pale?

faq.answer: Troggs have infested the lower reaches and outskirts of Gol'Bolar Quarry. They disrupt dwarven miners and scavenge equipment and explosive powder from the dig site.
faq.q: What are troggs doing near Gol'Bolar Quarry?

sections.body: At Gol'Bolar Quarry, a warning stamped on an empty keg shows that hazardous blasting powder has slipped out of authorized hands. The explosives are reserved for controlled quarrying, with the quarrymaster's direct approval. The keg was found among hostile troggs, and that points to a threat beyond ordinary trouble for the miners.
sections.title: A Dangerous Discovery

sections.body: When the empty keg reaches Quarrymaster Thesten, the dwarven overseers' worst fears are confirmed. Thesten turns pale: the blasting powder is gone, and subterranean troggs swarming the area have handled it. Now the quarry leaders must learn what the creatures mean to blast next.
sections.title: The Quarrymaster's Alarm

summary: Near Gol'Bolar Quarry, an empty keg of hazardous blasting powder has turned up among troggs. Its return to Quarrymaster Thesten reveals a breach in the quarry's security and explosive stores.
